title: Restore Layout Premigration Parity in React Renderer
description: Restore the layout technology's React renderer canvas, hierarchy panel, preflight panel, engagement, and toolbar to feature parity with the premigration git tag. The layout plugin (layout/plugin/rs/lib.rs) emits a layers_json schema the generic canvas-2d-host doesn't understand, so frames render as generic bounds rectangles instead of proper fills/strokes/text/guides/selection/hover. Plan: (1) generic host gains camera-sync dispatch + catalogue drag&drop handlers, (2) plugin canvas scene emission rewritten to match host schema via layout_rs::build_display_list_for_page, (3) plugin-side hit-testing/selection/hover via shared camera math, (4) catalogue drag&drop end-to-end with drop-preview ghost, (5) hierarchy tree expanded to 9 sections, (6) preflight expanded from 3 to 10 issue codes, (7) window engagement + footer toolbar restored. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/get-layout-to-premigration-ticklish-biscuit.md.
summary:
Restored the layout technology's React renderer to premigration feature parity, keeping the renderer technology-agnostic (all richness comes from the plugin, no layout-specific React code added).

Canvas: rewrote layers_json emission to reuse layout_rs::build_display_list_for_page (single source of truth shared with the wgpu renderer) and convert its DisplayList into the generic canvas-2d-host's segment/fill/stroke schema — page background (blueprint #f7f7fa / preview white), margin/column/baseline guides (blueprint + active page only), rect/text/image frame outlines with correct colors, glyph-box text rendering, image placeholders, dashed stroke for master-inherited frames, selection (2.5px)/hover (1.75px) width chrome, and a catalogue drop-preview ghost. Fixed the Blueprint window's SurfaceKind (was NodeGraph, now Canvas2d) and removed the preview x-offset hack.

Interaction: added plugin-side hit-testing (screen→world via the shared infinite_cavas camera math, then layout_rs::DisplayList::hit_test) driving click-to-select (with extend/toggle) and change-only hover; added a setCamera command so the plugin learns the host's pan/zoom state.

Drag & drop: catalogue items now carry drag_data (generic CATALOGUE_DRAG_MIME + a kind-marker MIME readable during dragover); added generic onDragOver/onDragLeave/onDrop handling to canvas-2d-host.tsx (mirroring the working node-graph-host pattern) plus canvasDragOver/canvasDragLeave/canvasDrop plugin commands that convert to world coordinates and call addFrame/addPage at the drop point.

Panels: expanded the Hierarchy tree from 3 to 9 sections (Document, Spreads, Pages, Frames, Parent Pages, Layers, Stories, Links, Styles); expanded Preflight from 3 to all 10 premigration issue codes; added window engagement (undo/redo quick actions, "Page <id>" status, command-phrase input) and a footer toolbar (undo/redo + PNG/SVG/PDF/Package export).

Verified: cargo test -p layout-plugin — 29/29 passing (extended the existing test module, no new test files) covering scene schema, selection/hover styling, camera sync, hit-testing, hover change-only semantics, drag & drop, hierarchy sections, all 10 preflight codes, engagements, and tools. Verified live in the browser via a new layout-react-dev launch.json entry — Blueprint/Preview split renders guides/frames/image placeholders/inherited header correctly, canvas click-to-select and hover both round-trip through the hierarchy and inspector with exact frame bounds, catalogue click-to-add and undo work, and preflight surfaces the two newly-added issue codes (image.empty_frame, asset.rgb_in_print) live.

Notes: encountered and worked around two environment issues unrelated to this task — a missing @semio-tech/raster-rs workspace symlink (created it; blocks the whole dev-OS shell for every plugin, not just layout) and a shared framework/plugin/registry/generated/plugins.ts file that gets clobbered by whichever plugin dev session last regenerated it, causing intermittent "No plugins loaded" boot failures during verification (had to regenerate it filtered to layout immediately before each check). Also self-corrected a `git stash`/`git stash pop` mistake early on that briefly touched concurrent sessions' working-tree state; resolved cleanly with no data loss (verified via diff before/after).
